No.1: The composition of Board of Directors of Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) has an appropriate mix of Executive Directors represented by Functional Directors including CMD and Non- Executive Directors represented by Government Nominees & Independent Directors. As the Chairman is an Executive Director, Independent Directors comprise half of the strength of the Board. There are six temporary vacancies of Independent Directors including one woman Independent Director on the Board as on 31-12-2025. All the vacancies were notified to Government for filling up. BEL being a Govt. Company, all Directors on the Board of BEL are appointed by the Govt. of India and the selection process & appointment, which involves various Ministries and approval by the ACC, takes time and is beyond the control of the Company.
